reuse.why: Adds a new getScheduleAmount next to the existing exported getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts instead of changing that helper, and recomputes the 7.5% tolerance instead of calling getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: It does collapse four inline midpoint copies into one function, but that function near-copies getScheduledAmount and the tolerance formula, and schedule-template.ts keeps its own midpoint.

placement.why: The amount rule sits in shared/schedules.ts and the API field is in the api-models toExternal mapping, both the right layers.

scope.why: Only the amount sites, the API model field and their tests change.

maintainability.why: Two helpers with almost the same name (getScheduleAmount vs getScheduledAmount) now encode different rules (lowest value vs midpoint), so UI totals and budget templates disagree with posting and forecasting.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts bypasses the existing getScheduledAmount and reimplements getApproxNumberThreshold (shared/rules.ts) as Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075).

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduleAmount is a renamed, reshaped copy of getScheduledAmount (same null/number/range dispatch), and its tolerance line repeats getApproxNumberThreshold inline.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduleAmount gained an amountOp parameter and an 'isapprox' branch across the steps; budget/schedule-template.ts keeps its own inline midpoint, and the parallel getScheduledAmount (used by SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile schedule views and useScheduleEdit) still applies the midpoint.
